description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.
